rawContent: Different women have different opinions about the “#metoo” movement. I see organizations speaking out against Lindsey Lohan right now. And I just want to remind women out there, it makes us all look weak when we speak against each other. No matter what side we are on.

When #MeToo hit the media, I broke. I was so angry. It took me a while to come around. Resharing my most controversial blog yet. Becuase it's the "anniversary" month of my rape. We all heal differently. https://t.co/I3uraL03o9

It's the 11th "anniversary" of the day I was raped. I avoided it until 7:39 PM. That's the time I saw inside the car I was pressed against. I remember the time. But I can't remember how I got home. I can't remember afterward. 5—that's how many people watched. Never again. #MeToo
